name: Sphere Assisted Raymarching
definition: A technique that stores the radius of the largest empty sphere centered at each voxel in a separate shape texture. This allows large steps through empty space by using the stored radius as a lower bound for the step size.
summary: Sphere Assisted Raymarching accelerates ray traversal by using a separate shape texture to store exact Euclidean distances to the nearest solid voxel, enabling larger steps through empty space than plane marching.
